title: Maps+ probe - layerVisibility regression and dark theme (MP-14, MP-15)
description: Probe harness. V1 is the SPL from upstream issue #67 (layerVisibility in 4.6.9). V2 is probe A with contextMenu=1, meant to be viewed in the Dark theme. Set the dashboard theme to Dark when creating it. See test/README.md.
